简介:
Born in Tottori Prefecture in 1976.
He is a famous commercial director having won numerous awards for his works, including the ACC Grand Prix, the ACC Best Director Award, the Advertising Dentsu Award, and the Grand Prize for Galaxy Award: CM Category. One of his best work is the popular “Santaro” series of AU which has been ranked first in the commercial favorites for 5 consecutive years (according to CM Research Institute, FY2014-FY2018).
He made his directorial debut in the movie "Not Quite Dead Yet".
